text:
kayla: Hey support — noticed some orgs (org_id=8042, 1199, 4210) have $0 or NaN in the token-cost dashboard and CSV export starting just after midnight UTC. Attached screenshot and CSV sample show NaN in `unit_price_usd` and blank price cells.

support: thanks — can you share a couple sample org_ids and the time window? any scheduled jobs or deploys at 00:00?

kayla: samples above, issue onset ~2024-11-04T00:05:00Z. No app deploys on product side. There was a nightly compaction/rollup at 00:00. CSV export includes header and `cost_usd` shows NaN for affected rows.

ethan: looping eng-oncall. my hunch: price lookup join dropped rows during the rollup so aggregate became NULL -> frontend shows $0 or NaN depending on render. I'll run a quick query.

eathan: running diagnostic: ```sql
SELECT l.org_id, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(l.ts) as start_ts, MAX(l.ts) as end_ts, SUM(l.tokens * p.unit_price_usd) as cost
FROM ledger l
LEFT JOIN price_lookup p ON p.model = l.model AND p.hour = DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts)
WHERE l.org_id IN (8042,1199,4210) AND DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts) = '2024-11-04 00:00:00'
GROUP BY l.org_id;
```

eathan: query shows cost is NULL for those orgs because p.unit_price_usd is NULL for several models.

sandeep: confirmed — fx-ingest consumer hit transient 429/timeouts for the 00:00 hour for a subset of model price feeds. The price_lookup table never received rows for those model/hour combos. Then the rollup compaction ran and produced aggregate rows with NULL price contribution.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert fired: price_lookup_missing for hour=2024-11-04T00:00:00Z at 1736553440; paged eng-oncall.

support: what's the repro and remediation plan so we can update affected customers?

eathan: repro steps: 1) reproduce query above for the affected hour; 2) `SELECT * FROM price_lookup WHERE hour = '2024-11-04T00:00:00Z' AND model IN (<list>)` — missing model rows indicate the bug; 3) re-run rollup and the dashboard should populate.

eathan: short-term mitigation: change rollup SQL to coalesce to a fallback price table so aggregates don't become NULL. e.g.:
```sql
-- temporary safe-rollup
SELECT l.org_id, SUM(l.tokens * COALESCE(p.unit_price_usd, d.fallback_price_usd, 0.0001)) AS computed_cost
FROM ledger l
LEFT JOIN price_lookup p ON p.model = l.model AND p.hour = DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts)
LEFT JOIN model_default_price d ON d.model = l.model
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts) = '2024-11-04 00:00:00'
GROUP BY l.org_id;
```

sandeep: I'm performing a backfill: ingest archived FX feed for the missing models and re-populate price_lookup for the hole. After that I'll re-run the rollup compaction for that hour. ETA ~ 20-30 minutes. The backfill will set `source='archive-fx'` and `backfill=true` in the table so downstream can detect it.

kayla: will notify customers with that ETA and recommend waiting to re-export CSVs until we finish. Any risk of double-charging when you re-run rollup?

sandeep: safe — rollup write path marks reprocessed rows with `reprocessed=true` and billing dedupe uses `ledger_row_id` + `rollup_hour` so we won't create duplicate billed events. Reprocessing also emits a replacement event to the audit log.

eathan: backfill completed at 1736553550 for most models. Started rollup reprocess at 1736553570. Quick sanity: org 8042 cost now shows non-zero in DB.

kayla: checked console — tile updated and CSV export now contains numeric `unit_price_usd` and `cost_usd` for the orgs I tested. I'll ping the 3 affected customers and ask to confirm.

support: please post the exact SQL snippet and a short blurb I can send to CS.

sandeep: SQL patch (to share):
```sql
-- emergency rollup fallback to avoid NaN showing to customers
INSERT INTO rollup_daily (org_id, hour, cost_usd, reprocessed)
SELECT l.org_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts) as hour,
       SUM(l.tokens * COALESCE(p.unit_price_usd, d.fallback_price_usd, 0.0001)) AS cost_usd,
       true AS reprocessed
FROM ledger l
LEFT JOIN price_lookup p ON p.model = l.model AND p.hour = DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts)
LEFT JOIN model_default_price d ON d.model = l.model
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('hour', l.ts) = '2024-11-04 00:00:00'
GROUP BY l.org_id;
```

sandeep: followup full backfill ensures true price values replace the fallbacks within the same rollup slot; we will update audit logs and notify finance.

eng-oncall-bot: runbook note appended: add retry/backoff to fx-ingest consumer and add a one-off healthcheck that validates price_lookup completeness for each hourly rollup.

kayla: customers acknowledged and said they're fine with reprocessed data; will close tickets once they confirm. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

support: closing ticket when all customers ack. great work all.

kayla: thx team :raised_hands:
